defect_free_strata.json.caveat: Only 6 positives in the defect-free strata, so the CI is wide; the point estimate sits at chance rather than above it, and the per-rule estimates (rule 2 n=31, rule 4 n=55) are individually unreliable.
defect_free_strata.json.conclusion: On the defect-free strata AUROC is 0.5078 with Mann-Whitney p=0.953 -- exactly chance. The no-signal finding is INDEPENDENT of the exemplar bug. Label noise was not attenuating a real signal.
defect_free_strata.json.method: Rules 3 (dosage) and 4 (omission) never had the exemplar-selection bug -- their evidence is the dose difference or the absence itself, not a selected mention. Restricting the gold evaluation to those strata gives a defect-free measurement.
defect_free_strata.json.question: Does the .iloc[0] exemplar bug explain ACCORD AUROC 0.460, or is the no-signal finding independent of it?

Falling back to rule-stratified (many-to-one) comparison, which is valid because rule membership counts match exactly (299=299) and rule is the only variable shared across both files.

weak_confidence_is_degenerate.finding: weak_confidence takes exactly 2 values (0.95, 1.00), and is a deterministic function of weak_label (0.95 iff contradiction, 1.00 iff not_contradiction) in all 1679 training rows and all 299 audit rows. It is not a real graded confidence score -- it cannot be swept as a threshold because it carries zero information beyond the label itself. Confidence-threshold precision curves (0.5/0.7/0.9/0.95) are therefore not meaningful: at any threshold <=0.95 every row passes; at 1.00 only not_contradiction rows pass by construction.

diag/step3_baselines.json.note: Only ACCORD (accord_contra_prob) is released as a continuous score across all 299 gold pairs, so only ACCORD has a true AUROC/AP (see step2). Baselines are binary calls; only ONE operating point is available per baseline (241 negatives released in aggregate only, per MIMIC DUA), so a full ROC/PR curve cannot be computed for llama_baseline / gpt4o_zeroshot / gpt4o_fewshot. single_point_pseudo_auc is the trapezoid through (0,0)-(FPR,TPR)-(1,1) at that one operating point -- a rough ranking heuristic, NOT a true AUROC, reported only because ACCORD continuous AUROC (~0.46-0.50) needs a reference point for "who ranks best".

diag/step4_threshold_fix_test.json.interpretation: If AUROC>>0.5, precision should rise well above the base rate as recall target is relaxed below the max. Since AUROC~0.46-0.50 (step2), precision at every recall target stays within noise of the 4.0% base rate -- no threshold on accord_contra_prob or accord_harm_score recovers usable precision. This is the operational test of the AUROC finding: a ranking with no signal cannot be rescued by moving the cutoff.
diag/step4_threshold_fix_test.json.max_precision_anywhere_on_curve_caveat: The 1.0 values above are the trivial edge point sklearn.precision_recall_curve always appends at recall=0 (no predictions made) -- not a genuine top-ranked hit. The actual top-15 highest-scored pairs by both accord_contra_prob and accord_harm_score are ALL pharmacist not_contradiction (0/15 hits, vs ~0.6 expected by chance).

top15_ranked_by_contra_prob_hit_rate.note: top 15 highest-scored pairs by accord_contra_prob; expected under random ranking ~15*0.04=0.6

top15_ranked_by_harm_score_hit_rate.note: top 15 highest-scored pairs by accord_harm_score; all 15 are pharmacist not_contradiction

calibration_check.interpretation: High match rate confirms accord_decontamination_audit.csv stores the pre-fix (.iloc[0]) exemplar actions -- i.e. what the pharmacist actually saw -- not the corrected exemplar. Residual mismatch is attributable to row-order differences between the mentions table snapshot used here and the exact extraction-time order of the original buggy pipeline.

audit_to_candidates_join.note: This join uses real shared keys present in BOTH files (both are internal MIMIC-derived tables from the same extraction pipeline), unlike the audit<->gold join which has no shared identifying key. Unmatched rows (if any) are likely candidates removed/altered between the two pipeline runs (e.g. weak-label pool vs full candidate pool) or rows for which sentence text changed slightly between extraction passes.

confounded_proxy_rule12_vs_rule34.warning: CONFOUNDED. This substitutes rule-identity (1+2 = defect-eligible rules, 3+4 = defect-free by construction) for the requested within-pair exemplar-correct/wrong split, because the pair_id<->HADM_ID join needed for the real test does not exist in files on this machine. Rule identity also carries real differences in clinical content and pharmacist base rate independent of the exemplar bug, so a difference here is not clean evidence of dilution, and a null result here does not rule dilution out.

power_analysis.statement: With 12 positives total split across 299 pairs, any two-group split of this sample size can only reliably detect very large absolute rate differences (computed below). Small-to-moderate dilution effects (e.g. a 5-10 point gap in positive rate) are not resolvable at this n.

multillm/per_model_results.json.system_prompt: You are a clinical pharmacist reviewing medication reconciliation between nursing progress notes and hospital discharge summaries. Your task is to identify dangerous medication contradictions. Respond with exactly one word: contradiction or not_contradiction.

confirmation_1.finding: At thresholds 0.05/0.10/0.15 the model gives precision 0.0474, recall 1.0, pos_rate 1.0 -- it predicts positive on every pair.
confirmation_1.significance: Independent prior confirmation of the 2026-08-05 diagnosis (contra_prob AUROC 0.460 vs pharmacist gold). No operating point recovers precision above the 4.0% base rate.

confirmation_2.action: Remove from any rebuttal. Reviewers JDYj and p4E8 asked for inter-rater reliability; this would read as evasion. Answer with a second annotator or the severity-ranking reframe.
confirmation_2.claim: internal_consistency_kappa = 1.000, described as two independent pharmacist instruments agreeing perfectly, with rebuttal_use = answers the N=1 annotator concern.
confirmation_2.problem: CIRCULAR. A not-contradiction has no danger by definition, so label==contradiction <=> danger_rating>0 is an identity, not an agreement measurement. kappa=1.000 is guaranteed by construction and measures nothing.

confirmation_3.claim: Only 2 of 1610 candidates resolved by intermediate notes -- validates the clinical need for automated detection.
confirmation_3.problem: The resolution regex contains both continue and discontinue among 20 alternations, so it matches nearly any medication sentence. 2/1610 is an instrument failure, not a measurement of clinical documentation practice.
